issues.explanation: The adaptation says董卓在省中“宣布废少帝为弘农王、立陈留王,” which reads as if the deposition and enthronement were already carried out in Chapter 3. In the source, Chapter 3 only presents董卓’s threatened proposal and袁绍’s confrontation; Chapter 4 contains the actual formal deposition.
issues.suggested_fix: Change to “宣布要废少帝为弘农王、立陈留王” or “提出废立少帝的计划”，so Chapter 4 can clearly enact the decision.
